title: Could you tell me where it is?

phrases.displayText: Could you tell me where the guided tour starts?
phrases.translation: Pode me dizer onde começa a visita guiada?

phrases.displayText: At the reception desk at ten. The talk is later, at eleven thirty
phrases.translation: Na recepção às dez. A palestra é depois, às onze e meia

phrases.displayText: Do you know if the tour is included in the entrance fee?
phrases.translation: Você sabe se a visita está incluída no ingresso?

phrases.displayText: The standard tour is included. The special workshop costs extra
phrases.translation: A visita normal está incluída. A oficina especial custa à parte

phrases.displayText: Thanks. Could you tell me where I can leave my bag?
phrases.translation: Obrigada. Pode me dizer onde posso deixar minha bolsa?

phrases.displayText: There’s a cloakroom on the ground floor, beside the information point
phrases.translation: Tem um guarda-volumes no térreo, ao lado do ponto de informações

phrases.displayText: And is the talk still in room two?
phrases.translation: E a palestra continua na sala dois?

phrases.displayText: That’s what the timetable says. Please check the board before you go
phrases.translation: É o que diz a programação. Confira o quadro antes de ir

voice.prompt: Send me a voice note: ask polite follow-up questions to plan a visit
voice.closing: Finish with one question for your teacher
